name: ja_cn_event4_session_probe_20260820_20260823
sql:
SELECT "$part_event" AS event_name, COUNT(*) AS event_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT "#account_id") AS accounts
FROM ta.v_event_4
WHERE "$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-08-20' AND '2026-08-23'
  AND LOWER("$part_event") LIKE '%session%'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY event_rows DESC
